facts_over_feelings.description: Emotions cloud judgment - only facts matter

evidence_weight.description: The evidence points to guilt, logically

episodic.content: The woman across the street - she saw the killing through the windows of a passing el train. That's eyewitness testimony.
The boy's alibi is weak. He claimed he was at the movies but couldn't name the film.

semantic.content: The murder weapon was traced to the defendant

history: His doubts seem emotional, not rational
